method.name: count
method.shortdesc: Displays the number of elements in the Note.

parameter.name: at
parameter.shortdesc: The location relative to the reference object or within the containing object. (Optional)

parameter.name: reference
parameter.shortdesc: The reference object. Note: Required when the at parameter specifies before or after. Can accept: Note or InsertionPoint. (Optional)

parameter.name: withProperties
parameter.shortdesc: Initial values for properties of the new Note (Optional)

method.name: item
method.shortdesc: Returns the Note with the specified index or name.

parameter.name: index
parameter.shortdesc: The index or name. Can accept: Long Integer or String.

method.name: itemByName
method.shortdesc: Returns the Note with the specified name.

method.name: itemByID
method.shortdesc: Returns the Note with the specified ID.

method.name: itemByRange
method.shortdesc: Returns the Notes within the specified range.

parameter.name: from
parameter.shortdesc: The Note, index, or name at the beginning of the range. Can accept: Note, Long Integer or String.

parameter.name: to
parameter.shortdesc: The Note, index, or name at the end of the range. Can accept: Note, Long Integer or String.

method.name: firstItem
method.shortdesc: Returns the first Note in the collection.

method.name: lastItem
method.shortdesc: Returns the last Note in the collection.

method.name: middleItem
method.shortdesc: Returns the middle Note in the collection.

method.name: previousItem
method.shortdesc: Returns the Note with the index previous to the specified index.

parameter.name: obj
parameter.shortdesc: The index of the Note that follows the desired Note.

method.name: nextItem
method.shortdesc: Returns the Note whose index follows the specified Note in the collection.

parameter.name: obj
parameter.shortdesc: The Note whose index comes before the desired Note.

method.name: anyItem
method.shortdesc: Returns any Note in the collection.

method.name: everyItem
method.shortdesc: Returns every Note in the collection.

method.name: toSource
method.shortdesc: Generates a string which, if executed, will return the Note.
Returns the Note with the specified index.

property.name: length
property.shortdesc: The number of objects in the collection.
